answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked until it completes a randomly assigned task and passes independent checks; only then does it earn reputation and a share of rewards. Splitting one identity into a plume of aliases does not multiply influence, because each alias needs its own funded bond and completed work. An attacker can echo honest behavior or reuse a relic of old credentials, but neither substitutes for current costly participation: the bonds tie up capital, while failed or duplicate accounts lose deposits and time.
